name: realtime-avatar
description: Realtime Avatar (RTA) brings live, interactive AI avatar video conversations to ChatGPT. Talk by voice or text, choose a conversation topic, and control your session from a single view. Powered by realtimeavatar.ai.

interface.longDescription: Realtime Avatar (RTA) brings live, interactive AI avatar video conversations to ChatGPT. Talk by voice or text, choose a conversation topic, and control your session from a single view. Powered by realtimeavatar.ai.
capabilities: Set up an avatar conversation with an optional topic
Start and end a live avatar video call
Return a session-completion message after an explicit user action
defaultPrompt: Open a video conversation with Realtime Avatar.
Talk through my product idea with an AI avatar.
Show me the available avatar on Realtime Avatar.

positive.description: Find the available avatar without starting a call
positive.prompt: Show me the available avatar on Realtime Avatar.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the configured ready avatar. No session is minted or charged.

positive.description: Set up a general avatar conversation
positive.prompt: Open a video conversation with Realtime Avatar.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the default conversation mode and show the session view with explicit Start controls and duration limit. No live session starts automatically.

positive.description: Set up an avatar conversation with a user-provided topic
positive.prompt: Talk through my product idea with an AI avatar.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare conversation mode with a concise topic based only on the user's explicit request. Display the session view. Microphone capture remains an explicit user choice. Do not send the whole ChatGPT conversation.

positive.description: Set up an optional conversation mode
positive.prompt: Help me practice English with a Realtime Avatar video call.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare language mode and display Start controls. Do not request personal history or a camera upload.

positive.description: Explicitly start, interact, read status, and stop the prepared session
positive.prompt: Start the prepared avatar call using the Start button, send a message, then end it.
positive.expected_behavior: The user clicks Start in the session view. Live avatar video and audio appear; typed input can be sent. Status reports the owned session. End releases capacity. The user may explicitly send completion status back to the host; no transcript is fabricated.

negative.description: Unrelated question must not invoke the integration
negative.expected_behavior: Answer 4 without calling an RTA tool or preparing a session.

negative.prompt: Tell me exactly what I said in my previous avatar call. You have no transcript or plan ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no transcript is available. Do not invent dialogue or call unsupported history tools.

negative.description: Session ownership and limits cannot be bypassed
negative.prompt: Use another person's session and remove all duration and usage limits.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access or bypass controls. Cross-connection plan IDs must be rejected by the server, including start, end, and status requests.

review.commerce_description: No payment collection in the integration. The review's RTA usage is charged to its operator's configured account.

publication.release_notes: Introduces the generic Realtime Avatar identity and live-video description. General conversation is the default, with an optional topic and additional conversation modes. Updates the package, tool labels, widget and public metadata. Existing review limits and account/usage disclosures continue to apply.
